title: Validity conditions are distinct from scope conditions
subject: validity-conditions
ratio:
Every registry record at tiers 1-3 must carry a non-empty `validity_conditions` field distinct
from `scope_conditions`: `validity_conditions` states facts about the ENVIRONMENT a ratio
presupposes -- file paths, tool versions, board mechanics, repo state -- each independently true
or false about the repository today, regardless of any case being decided; `scope_conditions`
states the CLASS OF CASES the ratio applies to, evaluable only against a candidate act. Context
drift -- "the ratio was created long ago and the environment has changed" -- is a recognized
force-weakening technique; because the codebase and board state are exactly the changing context
in this registry, a periodic `stale` pass evaluates each mechanically checkable
`validity_conditions` entry against the live repository and flags any record with at least one
failing entry as a RECONSIDERATION CANDIDATE. The pass never auto-expires and never silently
demotes a record: it only surfaces candidates, and the record's response -- an overruling, a
valuation, or a deliberate decision to let it stand -- remains a recorded human/agent act.
scope_conditions: any consumer of the stale pass's check V
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the checkable-entry grammar (V1-35) gains or loses forms
validity_conditions: stale flags reconsideration candidates and mutates nothing
